statement: In a normal-profile virtualgamepad 324d250bb01a5ddbfc1dd189513d4c9160429ee1 Steam 1794424036 run, all three rejected 0xae SETs used implemented selector 1 with declared length 1; their actual payloads were 63 bytes and numbered wire buffers 64 bytes. Selector-1 declared lengths 21 and 22 were each accepted once. The codec permits only those two declared lengths for selector 1, so these observed rejections are caused by overly strict declared-length validation rather than an unknown selector or a truncated request buffer. The fresh physical selector-1 comparison accepted declared length 1 with the same response shape as 21 and 22. This supports admitting the observed short form while preserving selector checks, actual-size validation, unsupported report handling and the existing serial reply shape. No change to other selectors or identity semantics is supported by this run.

applicability.firmware: Synthetic compatibility profile; no live firmware-version claim
applicability.scope: Metadata-only normal-use consumer trace plus exact source validation and physical selector-1 shape comparison. Does not identify unlogged selectors from earlier runs, prove universal physical behavior or qualify a product fix.
